title: Bitmap 内存模型：Android 8.0 前后的变化
key_conclusions: Bitmap memory must be separated into Java wrapper, native object, pixel storage, hardware/Graphics buffer, and image-library cache layers.
Android version and Bitmap configuration determine whether pixel cost is observed in Java Heap, Native Heap, Graphics, ashmem, or dma-buf evidence.
A single meminfo bucket is insufficient; Bitmap cases require HPROF retained paths plus meminfo/showmap/smaps or Graphics evidence.
Decode peaks, intentional caches, BitmapPool reuse, and real leaks must be separated before optimization.
shallow_points: The article does not include real Android 7.x, 8.x, and modern device before/after samples.
It does not validate exact Bitmap pixel accounting across vendor ROMs, Skia versions, and hardware bitmap paths.
It does not include a runnable image loading sample with software and hardware Bitmap variants.
It does not compare Glide, Coil, Picasso, and platform decoder cache behavior with real artifacts.
